edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.population: general adults receiving beta blockers outside acute MI
edges.mechanism: Outside clear indications, beta blockers mainly slow heart rate and lower blood pressure. That can relieve angina or arrhythmia, but it does not automatically translate into broad mortality benefit in lower-risk populations.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2026 Pu meta analysis in Int J Infect Dis already points to beta blockers produces mixed findings across studies, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
